headline: Brugge Diptych / PARA
context: Brugge Diptych is a temporary pavilion commissioned for the 2021 Brugge Triennale. Set along a quiet residential canal, it abuts an abandoned fifteenth-century house in a dense UNESCO-protected neighborhood.
